title: Synthetic motion (made-up practice data)
summary: Twelve made-up daily frames of a pretend current that moves east by exactly two grid cells a step, for practice and tests.
description: A pretend sea with a current in a band across the middle: six round patches, four warm and two cold, on flat mild water. Every day each patch moves east by exactly two grid cells and nothing else changes, so the motion between any two frames is known exactly. Every value is chosen by us. None of it is real data.

source.name: Made-up practice data
source.credit: Made up for testing; not NASA data

regions.name: Open sea
regions.description: A grid of 30 points across the map, clear of the edges.
